title: Arrival + Lady Bee

weather.note: Grey & mild; coastal fog, high humidity, little sun. Light jacket, not a raincoat.

glance: Land off the redeye at 6:55 AM — take it easy. Check in, nap, gentle wander, then 8 PM cocktails at Lady Bee.

reservations.name: Lady Bee
reservations.address: Lady Bee, Av. Pedro de Osma 205, Barranco, Lima
reservations.note: Wed Sept 16, 20:00. Peru's top-ranked cocktail bar (World's 50 Best); small plates too — arrive a little hungry.

picks.name: Malecón de Miraflores
picks.note: Clifftop boardwalk over the Pacific; paragliders, ocean air, sunset. Walk to Parque del Amor.

picks.name: Parque Kennedy / Cat Park
picks.note: Dozens of friendly resident cats, artists, food carts. Grab picarones from a cart.

picks.name: Ceviche lunch
picks.note: Get the classic in today so Maido stands alone tomorrow. See La Mar, Canta Rana and Isolina below.
